title: Information sharing: SQL Server 2025 is now GA – Business Central to Support it in 2026 Release Wave 1 (BC28)
summary: SQL Server 2025 has reached general availability with expanded resource limits, and Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28) will support it. On-premises Business Central customers can benefit from increased memory capacity in SQL Server Standard Edition for improved query performance.
key_points: SQL Server 2025 Standard edition now supports up to 32 cores and 256 GB of memory, compared to previous limits
Express edition database size limit increased to 50 GB, with Express Advanced consolidated into unified SQL Express
SQL Server Web edition is being discontinued; SQL Server 2022 is the final Web edition version
Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28) will support SQL Server 2025 for on-premises deployments

quotes.text: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 will of course support running on SQL Server 2025.
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms official support timeline for on-premises customers planning infrastructure upgrades
